talk.jaymoskingdoms.changeling.found.0: I only wanted a hearth. %s had one.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.changeling.found.1: Don't! I never hurt %s. I only borrowed the face.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.changeling.found.2: It was a good life, %s's. I'd have kept it kindly.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.doubt.ask.place.0: Hold there. After what we saw, I ask everyone. What is this place called?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.doubt.ask.place.1: A moment. Anyone could be wearing a face now. Name the ground you stand on.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.doubt.ask.place.2: Not a step closer. If you are who you look like, you know where you are. Say it.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.doubt.ask.wife: Wait. If it is really you, tell me who you go home to.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.doubt.ask.dog: Stop there. You would know this. What is your dog called?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.doubt.ask.colour: One thing, and then I'll let you be. What colour is %s?
talk.jaymoskingdoms.doubt.right.0: Good. Forgive me. Nobody trusts a face this week.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.doubt.right.1: That's right. Go on, then. I had to ask.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.doubt.right.2: Aye, it's you. I'll tell the others.
talk.jaymoskingdoms.doubt.wrong.0: That's wrong. That's WRONG! It's another one!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.doubt.wrong.1: No. No, it isn't. Get back from me!
talk.jaymoskingdoms.doubt.wrong.2: Liar! Whatever you are, you are not who you look like!
